reviews.title: Hate the new update
reviews.text: I used to be able to slide the slider across the huntcast timeline and get the predicted movement percentage, temperature, and wind speed all at the same time. Now I have to slide the slider to the time, then slide the slider across the top to see the movement percentage for that hour, and I no longer have the ability to see temperature.  Will not be renewing my subscription

reviews.title: Any useful feature costs more every year
reviews.text: Every year they take away a feature so you will pay for it. Then they move that feature into higher tier the next year. On top of that the info has not aligned with deer movement in my area in the slightest. The gps is not very good for marking stands and trails. Ask me 5 years ago I would have said it was great. But the greed of the app owners/developers are driving it into the ground

reviews.title: Terrible customer service
reviews.text: I got the free trial with a hunters Ed course and then couldn’t ever figure out how to cancel it. When I reached out for help they didn’t help at all and there was never any way to actually speak to someone real. I couldn’t ever get a refund for my year subscription that I didn’t want in the first place and have never used. I’ll probably get charged next year too because it’s impossible to cancel if you didn’t sign up directly through the app.

reviews.title: Takes your person information and sells it!
reviews.text: I have recently dealt with several trespassers that claim it’s ok to hunt on my private land. They state they know me when talking to me (not knowing it’s me they are speaking with). I also started to receive a lot of unsolicited phone calls asking to use my farm for hunting. All claim it’s from this app. Basically this app takes your personal information and sells it via a subscription to hunters. They say it’s ok because it’s “public information” they pull the information from the same place a realtor would. I have submitted complaints everywhere I can. I think it’s wild they can sell my personal information.

reviews.title: Why I gave a 2 star
reviews.text: The app was amazing. I saw everything I wanted like wind direction and percent of deer movement.  I woke up on Friday to go Hunting that morning and the app would not let me see the dear percentage on it. I am so mad with this right now if it would not give me the week, I would put a one star on here. I am so mad it will not show me the weekend. You know one star. You have to pay 19 dollars a month or over 50 dollars a year. 😡😡😡it said 22% movement of deer. So please take a guess what was at my stand!! A lot of deer!!! Btw, that was on Monday!!!

reviews.title: Back to the future?
reviews.text:
How come just before this last update I had to call 30 plus times and still never got a refund or some type of compensation due to the fact that my app wasn’t working properly (the huntcast) finally came out with an update and now land ownership names are reverted back to 2020 or before!   I know this because when I looked up a name it said my mother still owned a house that she sold back in 2020!  What a joke this app has become and I just got charged about a week ago for my elite subscription for the year yet every time almost when I open the app I have ads popping up and blocking my screen that I have to close out of!! I paid for the elite and still get ads/spam and reverted landownership. 🤦🏻‍♂️🤦🏻‍♂️🤬🤬🤬
Send me my refund please!
